summary: AT&T Inc. filed a Form 8-K with items 8.01 (Other Events) and 9.01 (Financial Statements and Exhibits) on August 17, 2026, listing numerous series of preferred stock and global notes. The filing appears to be a routine notice regarding its registered securities, not a special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or strategic review. No terms, prices, or recommendations are disclosed. This is a standard listing of securities and does not trigger any special-situations classification.
